plugin.note: Common spiders have 2 hitpoints and negligible defence, so any weapon kills them instantly; melee is the fastest for a nuisance task. Their 50% fire weakness makes fire spells an option for players training magic. On a Krystilia task, kills must occur in the Wilderness - bring risk gear.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness), Turael and Spria.
Krystilia kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: The common Spider (npc 3019) has 2 hitpoints, a max hit of 0 and negligible defensive bonuses.
Spiders rarely drop anything of value; the task is a fast nuisance clear.
Deadly red spiders are a separate Slayer task and do not count.

methods.label: Melee the spiders
methods.summary: Kill common spiders with any melee weapon; they die in one hit.
steps: Travel to a spider spawn (a Wilderness spot for Krystilia, any common spawn for Turael/Spria).
Attack the spiders; they have 2 hitpoints and negligible defence.
notes: On a Krystilia task the kills must occur in the Wilderness; bring risk gear.

methods.label: Fire spells
methods.summary: Spiders carry a 50% fire weakness, so fire spells are an option for players training magic.
steps: Cast a fire spell on the spiders; their 50% fire weakness boosts accuracy and damage.
For a Krystilia task, remain in the Wilderness for the kills to count.
notes: Overkill for 2-hitpoint spiders, but useful for magic experience.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Any melee weapon one-shots the low-hitpoint spiders.
